reuse.why: Extends the existing isSkippedByMonthAction predicate that every month-wide action already calls, rather than adding new filtering.

duplication.why: The hidden rule stays in the one predicate; the new options type is shared by all six actions and the diff adds no copied logic.

placement.why: The flag is honoured inside the shared skip predicate in budget/actions.ts, next to the other exclusions.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the action signatures and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Clean single-point change; the positional boolean and the pre-existing per-action loops that repeat the income check are minor friction but not introduced here.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions keep routing the decision through isSkippedByMonthAction.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic added; only parameter pass-through at each action.
